notes.title: The Defense Gamemode
notes.content:
Putting the defense back in tower defense!

[h1]New Experimental Gamemode[/h1]
This update adds a new gamemode available when playing the new map "Valley Defense". Instead of the usual spawning mechanics, robots now spawn in a series of increasingly difficult waves. Place your mushrooms, call in the wave, and watch your fungi fend off the incoming automatons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44944335/0ccac3978335d3f204867e7d64560f13345ac959.png[/img]
Instead of the usual mycelium spreading mechanic, you start with a small starting area that automatically expands as you complete waves. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44944335/4dba51153a737155c3fc7b3b916b1abb2323c722.png[/img]
Mushrooms do not generate new cards themselves. Instead, you get a full hand of mushroom cards before a wave and a full card of ability cards during the wave. Additionally, OM generation only happens once, at the end of the wave.

[h1]Full Update Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] New: Defense gamemode
[*] New: Agriculture Shroom
[*] New: OM icon
[*] New: UI feedback when mushroom failed to place
[*] New: Esc now deselects the card in the hand
[*] Fix: Failsafe implemented to prevent an issue where robots would stop spawning after a wave
[*] Fix: Bots sometimes dying in the climbing animation
[*] Fix: Loss is now triggered if out of mushroom cards and no mushrooms are placed
[/list]

notes.title: EA.02.02
notes.content:
Minor update with a few small additions and fixes made over the past few months. A larger update will be coming soon(tm).

[list]
[*] New: Fast forwarding: x1, x2, x4 speeds
[*] New: Ground terrain attenuation values are now dependant on height. This also means terrain will show properly on the minimap
[*] New: Textures for Virtual Codeprinopsis and Emergency Penicillium
[*] Fix: First projectile from some mushrooms flying in a random direction
[*] Fix: Ground terrain on maps Fort, valley, and Hill has been tweaked to be slightly smoother
[*] Fix: Robots now consistently path to the closest available spot to eat mushrooms
[/list]

- Chilton
[i](@technocat5000)[/i]

notes.title: The Projectile Update
notes.content:
Tired of spores not obeying the laws of physics??


Well they still don't really, but It is slightly more realistic now.


[h1]Projectile Arcs[/h1]
Gravity exists!
Projectiles now arc through the air. They also travel slightly slower overall, so shooting mushrooms now make an attempt to lead their shots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44944335/26114f31ca044534df957cb8937e391c58acbc21.gif[/img]

[h1]Projectile Collision[/h1]
Hit detection was previously nonexistant; Shrooms simply picked the closest target, sent a spore linearly in that direction, and damage was applied once the spore reached its destination, irrespective of how far the robot actually was from the spore at that point in time.
Damage is now done purely based on collision. Additionally, terrain objects now block projectiles and line of sight, increasing the need to tactically place offensive mushrooms on higher levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44944335/77fa41302c4d47beba84a7c670e6a65cb6191372.gif[/img]

[h1]New Content[/h1]
Along with the projectile mechanic overhaul this update adds a new map and two new mushroom cards: a brand new projectile shroom, and a super variant of the crystalshroom.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44944335/ed123ddbeae365e9917857f1390d4260637455ea.png[/img]

[h1]Full Update Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] New: Ground-up overhaul of projectile mechanics:
[list]
[*] Projectiles now have physics and gravity.
[*] Hit detection is now done via physics collision.
[*] Projectiles can now collide with terrain; Most shrooms must now have LOS to shoot.
[/list]
[*] Balance: All shooting shrooms have had various stats tweaked to maintain balance. 
[*] New: Shroom placement ghost now turns red when it cannot be placed.
[*] New: Cursor circle now indicates range of shrooms.
[*] New: Audio feedback when invalid action attempted.
[*] New: Super Crystal Variant.
[*] New: Shroom "Troweltail".
[*] New: Map “Fort".
[*] Fix: Bug allowing mushrooms to be placed on top of outposts.
[*] Fix: Mushrooms generating negative OM.
[/list]


- Chilton
[i](@technocat5000)[/i]

notes.title: Day 1 Patch (EA.01.03)
notes.content:
Minor changes and fixes for bugs that inevitably appeared on release day:

[list]
[*] New Feature: Card, Map, and difficulty selections are now saved.
[*] Change: Reworked Alfred's to do damage per 0.5s tick rather than every frame. Also tweaked damage values slightly.
[*] Balance: Lowered base and outpost health.
[*] Balance: Reduced damage of fast enemies.
[*] Balance: Sligtly reduced damage of Turbinellus and it's super variant.
[*] Balance: Tweaked Med and Hard wave enemy amounts to be more manageable.
[*] Balance: Increased card drop frequency slightly.
[*] Balance: Decreased card price scaling slightly.
[*] Fix: MapHIll: Changed terrain tiles to use the same sloped models as MapValley.
[*] Fix: MapHIll: Fixed the starting log and rock missing the overlay textures.
[*] Fix: Logger error when some mushrooms are damaged.
[*] Fix: Logger error when enemies try to path to a destroyed mushroom.
[*] Fix: Logger error when projectile mushrooms dealt AOE damage. 
[*] Fix: Bug that allowed stacking multiple cards such as Mycorr on a single mushroom.
[*] FIx: Bug causing damaged outposts to spawn infinite robots.
[*] Fix: Bug preventing the penicillium from getting the OM bonus when no nearby mushrooms are damaged.

As always, please contact us with any further issues or feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/TsXUcZ6SzJ]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Early Access
notes.content:
It has been just over two months since the GameJam that created Fungal Fiefdom ended. And with about a month to go until EA release we thought we'd share a quick update on what the team's been up too, and what to expect.

[h1]New mycelium propagation[/h1]
The mycelium growth has been entirely overhauled. Previously, it was just a circular decal that slowly scaled up. Now, the mycelium propagates through and around terrain (slightly) more realistically. Most obstacles slow mycelium generation somewhat, rocks being particularly difficult for it to penetrate, and trees and barriers blocking growth entirely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44944335/200c81831f60bf293846a99cc72ec03dc07c6321.gif[/img]

[h1]New terrain capabilities[/h1]
Along with more obstacle generation optimisations and backend improvements, the terrain and navigation mesh systems have been generalised. This allows us to have multiple terrain heights, creating more interesting layouts.
Both this and the new mycelium propagation (and some super secret new features) allow us to create interesting maps for more varied tactical challenges. Some of these will be hand crafted, some randomly generated, and some a mix of both.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44944335/ecba1f5c60bc7c6a8330ea12a1719d330ae6836e.png[/img]

[h1]Progression[/h1]
Whilst we are proud of our game as it was for the jam, one map doesn't provide a huge amount of replayability, even with the randomness of the terrain and card drops. In order to enchourage playing more than just one round there will be a few features to create a path of progression. Including new maps, a chance to unlock more powerful mushrooms, and progressively more challenging enemies to use them on. A set of achievements will also add difficult goals to work towards over multiple games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44944335/cbd549d62cd5a61603f4ed37e891e7c896342282.png[/img]

[h1]Other cool stuff[/h1]
There's more minor changes and optimisations than are worth mentioning here. However Some of the notable content additions:
[list]
[*] New cards
[*] New enemies
[*] Overhauled enemy AI
[*] More settings and options
[*] Better visibility
[*] More stuff I'm probably forgetting to mention
[/list]


Thank you for showing an interest in Fungal Fiefdom, and we hope to see you at release!
Come and join our discord if you fancy a chat with us.
[url=https://discord.gg/TsXUcZ6SzJ][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44944335/ccfb37d27ae7780f5e04b5f346e4d90b6d15812a.png[/img][/url]

- Chilton
